title: PerioRisk: periodontitis risk screening from self-reported questions
description: PerioRisk estimates the probability of moderate or severe periodontitis (CDC/AAP surveillance case definition) from 14 self-reported questions that follow the NHANES wording. A calibrated gradient-boosting model was developed on NHANES 2009–2012 (n = 7,050) and temporally validated on NHANES 2013–2014 (n = 3,610): AUC 0.781 (95% CI 0.766–0.796), calibration slope 0.91, observed/expected ratio 0.90; survey-weighted AUC 0.785 with design-based confidence intervals. Decision-curve, subgroup (fairness) and transportability analyses are reported following TRIPOD+AI. The fitted model is exported to a portable JSON format and re-implemented in pure Python and JavaScript, reproducing scikit-learn's predictions for all 10,660 participants to within 1e-12. It ships as a dependency-free Python package and command-line tool (pip install periorisk), a private in-browser application (answers never leave the device) and a one-command pipeline that rebuilds the published model exactly from public CDC data. Educational and research tool; not a diagnosis or a medical device.
